verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe bulk operations like 'fixing lint errors across a project,' multi-file code changes, parallel subagents (10s-100s), spawning multiple agents to divide a task, and multi-session parallel work in the web/CLI. Community evidence corroborates multi-language project handling at scale, though also notes reliability issues on repetitive/replace-all operations (e.g. replace_all bug) showing real-world friction. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of bulk-operation accuracy at scale and clearer documentation of failure/rollback handling for bulk edits.
